name: Context menus
author: Brett
description: Every context menu of the app in one place, kept as ONE TRUE SOURCE on axHub (context-menu@1 documents in the hub's shared data, readable and writable by every plugin, app and Claude session through the hub API and the capability context-menus@1). Each menu is a standard context-menu asset the runtime draws; the page lists them all (search, per app / level / zone, who made them, which one each app shows) with Preview, Edit, Use, snapshots and Restore like skins. The zone registry maps every right-click target the code draws (and what open consoles report), with its owner plugin and pages; with the UI Manager on, each zone links to its elements (ui-elements@1). Generate with Claude at a coder level: BEGINNER a few big obvious actions, AMATEUR the common actions, PRO the full working set grouped with shortcuts, ADVANCED CODER a meticulous map of every zone with deep actions (tokens, API addresses, inspect, copy ids, run commands). Higher levels map the app more meticulously; menus stay slim (rare items fold under More…). The level can differ per app and page. Always a preview before applying. Greyed out with a clear reason when Claude is not ready. Full API: REST, MCP context_menus_*, `axf context-menus …`, the actions context-menus.* and voice ('generate pro context menus').

items.title: Context menus state
items.description: Every menu (and which one each app shows), the four coder levels, the zone registry, open drafts, whether Claude is ready, where the store is (the hub's shared data = one true source).

items.title: List context menus
items.description: Every context menu, filtered by words (q), app, level, zone or source.

items.title: One context menu
items.description: The context-menu@1 document (the asset inside) and its history list.

items.title: Zone registry
items.description: Every right-click zone the code draws (data-fx-ctx-target + the implicit toolbar / tab row / nav / anywhere), with owner, weight, pages and elements. scan=true rescans the code.

items.title: Coder levels
items.description: beginner, amateur, pro, advanced: items per zone, depth, which zones, shortcuts, developer actions.

items.title: Actions a menu item may run
Is Claude ready to generate?
items.description: The models service is there; live=true also runs the credits check the Claude badge shows green for.

items.title: The prompt Claude gets
items.description: Zero tokens: the system + user prompt for a level, app and page, with the zones and actions it lists.

items.title: Save a context menu
items.description: Save a context-menu@1 document (validated; the previous version is kept as a snapshot).

items.title: Restore a snapshot
items.description: Put a menu back to one of its snapshots (v), like a skin.

items.title: Use a menu
items.description: Make this menu the one its app shows; every open console follows.

items.title: Report the zones on screen
items.description: An open console tells the registry which zones its current page draws (items: [{id, label, elements}], page).

items.title: Generate context menus with Claude
items.description: Map the app's zones at a coder level with Claude and return a DRAFT with a preview (the menu, warnings, what changes against the menu in force). Nothing is applied until apply, unless apply is true. Spends Claude tokens; refused with aiMissing when Claude is not ready.

page.description: one page only (blank = the whole app)

items.output: { ok, draft: ctx-draft@1 { id, menu, warnings, diff, summary }, model }

items.title: Apply a draft
items.description: Save the draft as a menu and make it the one its app shows (use=false saves without switching).

items.title: Voice: one sentence
items.description: 'generate pro context menus', 'preview beginner menus for the console', 'apply', 'list context menus', 'use menu <id>': the sentence is read and run (a generate returns the draft to preview).
